__broaden__.ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’)
__broaden__.πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, functioning as an adverb) — beside, alongside; adv. · also a preposition + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ Νέστορα) · also preverb in tmesis (πὰρ … θῆκεν = παρέθηκε ’set before’) · also a preposition + dat., ’beside’ (πὰρ πυρί ’beside the fire’)
__broaden__.τινας: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. acc. pl.: ’some, certain’ · also with a relative, οὕς τινας ’whichever, whoever’
__broaden__.ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’)
__broaden__.ῥηξήνορος: ῥηξήνωρ — breaking the ranks of men (standing epithet of Achilles); masc. gen. sg. · also the proper name Ῥηξήνωρ, Rhexenor, father of Arete; masc. gen. sg.
__broaden__.ἀρήτη: Ἀρήτη — Arete, queen of the Phaeacians (name from ἀρητός ’prayed for’); fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., address: ’Arete!’
__broaden__.κοίτου: κοίτη — bed, going to bed, rest; gen. sg., governed by μέδηται ’takes thought of’ · also gen. governed by μιμνήσκομαι ’think of’ (μνησαίατο κοίτου ’had bed in mind’)
__broaden__.μηδέ: μηδέ — and not, nor, do not; neg. conj., used to forbid before an imperative · also continuing a purpose clause with the subjunctive: ’and not’ (μηδέ … πάθῃσι ’and may he not suffer’)
__broaden__.πινέμεν: πίνω — drink; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic πίνειν), used as an imperative: ’drink!’ · also complementary inf. after κέλεται: ’to drink’
__broaden__.πομπῆς: πομπή — sending, escort, conveyance; fem. gen. sg., + gen. with τυγχάνω · also gen. governed by περί: ’about a conveyance’
__broaden__.πῆμα: πῆμα — woe, calamity, disaster; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’woe’
__broaden__.ἡγήτορες: ἡγήτωρ — leader, chief; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., address: ’leaders!’
__broaden__.ἄλλ: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. sg., elided (ἄλλ’ = ἄλλο): ’another thing’ · also neut. nom./acc. pl. ἄλλα, elided, genuinely ambiguous with the sg. reading: ἄλλ’ ἐνόησεν ’devised other things’ or ’another thing’ · also the conjunction ἀλλά ’but’, elided, as printed before ἄγε: ἄλλ’ ἄγε δή ’but come now’
__broaden__.ἕο: reflexive pron. (= ἑαυτοῦ, Attic οὗ) — himself; gen. sg. · also referring back to a feminine subject: ’of herself, of it’ (ἐκέλευσεν ἕο μνήσασθαι, of the belly, ’bids one think of it’)
__broaden__.αἶσα: αἶσα — portion, lot, destiny; fem. nom. sg., used impersonally with an inf.: ’it is not his lot to…’ · also plain subject: ’portion, lot’ (ἅσσα οἱ αἶσα … νήσαντο ’whatever his portion … spun for him’)
__broaden__.ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
